name: Mah Sing Group Berhad
summary: Mah Sing Group Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and manufacturing businesses in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Australia, Africa, the Philippines, the United States, Turkey, Vietnam, Thailand, and internationally. It operates through Property, Manufacturing, and Investment Holding and Others segments. The Property segment invests in and develops residential, commercial, and industrial properties. Its Manufacturing segment is involved in the manufacture and trade of a range of plastic molded products and gloves.
